name: Pau D`Arco with Mate
headline: Pau D`Arco with Mate
description: Pau d'arco (lapacho) bark extract with olive leaf and yerba mate extracts helps activate the body's immunity, raise vitality and give a feeling of energy.
howToUse: Adults – 3 capsules once a day in the first half of the day, with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Pau d'arco (lapacho) bark extract, olive leaf extract, yerba mate leaf extract, excipients.
